part.text:
Fixed `OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator.preceding(int)` to initialize its binary-search cursor at the lower middle index:

```java
currentSentence = (sentenceStarts.length - 1) / 2;
```

This prevents an out-of-bounds `sentenceStarts[currentSentence + 1]` access when there are exactly two detected sentences.
